title: Aurélie — Frequently Asked Questions
html:
Help

Questions, answered.

Orders & shipping
How long does delivery take? +

Ready-to-ship pieces arrive in 3–5 working days anywhere in India, fully insured and in tamper-evident packaging. Made-to-order and bridal pieces carry their own timeline — typically 4–12 weeks — shown on the product page before you order.

Is shipping really free and insured? +

Yes — every order ships free within India, insured door to door for its full value. A signature and OTP are required on delivery.

Do you ship outside India? +

We ship worldwide via insured courier. International duties are the recipient's responsibility and are estimated at checkout. Our travelling team also holds private viewings in London, Dubai and Singapore.

Can I pay cash on delivery? +

COD is available on orders up to ₹ 1,00,000 within India. UPI, cards, net banking and EMI on all major banks are also accepted.

Returns & lifetime service
What is your return policy? +

15 days, no questions asked, with free doorstep pickup. Pieces must be unworn with the hallmark tag intact. Bespoke and engraved commissions are exchange-only.

What does lifetime service include? +

Complimentary polishing, re-plating, prong checks and resizing — for as long as you own the piece, however long ago it was bought. Write to the atelier and we arrange insured pickup.

Can I exchange an old piece? +

Yes. Aurélie pieces carry lifetime exchange at the prevailing gold rate against any new piece; the karigar's making charge is credited in full within five years of purchase.

Gold & certification
Is every piece hallmarked? +

Every gold piece carries a BIS hallmark with HUID. Diamonds above 0.2 ct ship with an SGL or IGI certificate, and each piece includes the signed commission card of the karigar who made it.

How is the price affected by the gold rate? +

Prices are re-computed daily against the market rate. When a piece enters your bag, its quoted price is held for 48 hours.

Are your diamonds ethically sourced? +

All stones are conflict-free, sourced through Kimberley Process–compliant suppliers, and traceable to origin on request. We are members of the Responsible Jewellery Council.

Bespoke & sizing
How do I find my ring or bangle size? +

Use our size guide, or ask us to post you a complimentary sizing kit. If a piece arrives and the size isn't right, resizing is free — always.

How does a bespoke commission work? +

It begins with a conversation — at the Jaipur atelier or over a video call. We sketch, quote, and carve a wax model for your approval before any metal is poured. Bridal commissions take a minimum of twelve weeks.
